messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Metro Commercial Bank ki taraf se salam. Aap ke dormant account ka refund 95,000 rupay clear ho gaya hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Purana salary account jo 2019 se band hai. Refund chahiye to apna active IBAN/account number confirm kar dein.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aur mobile banking PIN bhi update kar dein taake transfer turant ho jaye.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ji system requirement hai. Jaldi karein refund queue kal tak expire ho jati hai.
